note.headline: Cemindia QIP closes at Rs1,108/share (4.37% discount to Rs1,158.58 floor), raising ~Rs1,400cr
thesisChain: Management Committee closes the QIP on 19-Oct-2026 and allocates 1,26,35,379 equity shares at Rs1,108.00/share (Rs1,107 premium on Re1 face value)
Issue price is a 4.37% discount to the SEBI-formula floor price of Rs1,158.58, implying gross proceeds of roughly Rs1,400cr
This confirms and finalises the pricing signal already flagged on 14-Oct-2026 when the QIP opened at that floor price
Fresh equity strengthens the balance sheet for an EPC/construction company and funds working-capital/growth capex, offsetting near-term EPS dilution from the new shares

epsImpact.magnitude: ~1.26cr new equity shares issued -- near-term EPS dilution, with proceeds (~Rs1,400cr) intended to fund growth/working capital

note.insight: Formal exchange filing (Regulation 30), and a FOLLOW-UP that finalises the QIP already flagged as 'high' significance on 14-Oct-2026 when it opened at the Rs1,158.58 floor price. What is new today: the issue closed at Rs1,108.00/share (a 4.37% discretionary discount), with 1,26,35,379 shares allotted to QIBs, implying gross proceeds of roughly Rs1,400cr -- a large capital raise for Cemindia Projects (formerly ITD Cementation India). The raise dilutes existing shareholders mechanically but strengthens the balance sheet; BRLMs were SBI Caps, ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital per the 14-Oct note. Watch the use-of-proceeds disclosure and the next quarter's order-book/working-capital commentary to see whether this funds bid capacity for larger EPC orders.
